title: The Lion King
blurb: The animated original with two follow-ups, plus the 2019 remake and a 2024 prequel to it.

thelion98.t: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride

note: The Lion King 1½ retells the original from Timon and Pumbaa's side, starting before it — in the UK it was released as The Lion King 3: Hakuna Matata. Mufasa is a prequel to the 2019 remake specifically.
